explainer.lead: TeLQAS is an experimental question answering system built to answer English questions in the telecommunications domain. It matters as an early domain-specific QA effort rather than a general-purpose one.

tiers.eli5: It is a computer program that tries to answer questions written in English about telecom topics.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers treat it as a domain-restricted QA system, useful as a reference point for telecom question answering. The available facts give no architecture or evaluation details, so its practical pitfalls cannot be stated.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as an experimental question answering system for answering English questions in the telecommunications domain; no formal definition or limits are available beyond that scope.
